clauses.title: In the Contract, as defined in the Particular Conditions attached to these Conditions of Contract as Appendix A, the following words and expressions shall have the meanings hereby assigned to them except where the context otherwise requires:-
clauses.content: (a) "Advance Payment Bond" means the bond named in Clause 7.1 (Provision of Bonds) as the Advance Payment Bond. (b) "Bills of Quantities" means the document entitled bills of quantities, duly completed and priced, forming a part of the Contract.

sections.title: PROJECT MANAGER AND PROJECT MANAGER'S REPRESENTATIVE

clauses.title: The Project Manager shall have such powers, discretions, functions and authorities as are specified in the Contract and as may be implied therefrom and shall carry out such duties (including without limitation issuing instructions, decisions, certificates, orders, determinations, consents, notices and approvals) as are specified in the Contract.
